title: Hilb^d of a scheme with affine-opens through points is representable
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter pic.tex (Picard Schemes of Curves)

difficulty_reason: Prove Hilbfunctor^d_{X/S} is representable when every d-tuple of points of a fibre lands in a common affine open: reduce to S affine (relative glueing or the functorial point of view, details omitted); for each affine open U of X define the subfunctor F_U of subschemes contained in U_T; verify the glue-functors conditions: (1) sheaf property; (2)(a) F_U = Hilbfunctor^d_{U/S} representable by lemma-hilb-d-An, with the closed-immersion discussion (footnote handles the non-separated case via the pointwise argument); (2)(b) the open T_{Z,U} where the fibre maps into U; (2)(c) from the hypothesis, since a degree-d finite flat Z over a field has at most d points in one fibre.
